'''Team BDS''' was a Swiss esports organization, based in Geneva. The team used to compete in the [[LFL]] but bought a spot in the [[LEC/2022 Season/Spring Season|LEC]] in June 2021.

Following a series of major strategic developments announced in June 2025<ref>[https://x.com/TeamBDS/status/1939685363728949592 Team BDS' X Post]</ref>, the organization officially rebranded as [[Shifters]] in December 2025.<ref>[https://x.com/ShiftersGG/status/2000644103629844506 Shifters' X Post]</ref>''
